ledger.text: Hours later.
Is anyone still alive?
A radio crackles above Harbor Street.
A radio crackles above Harbor Street.
Mia: Is it over? Please say it’s over. Take me with you.
A voice, softly praying, from the church.
A voice, softly praying, from the church.
A voice, softly praying, from the church.
Mr. Okafor: Bless you, child. Please, take me with you.
A flashlight blinks inside the wrecked bus on Lakeshore Avenue.
A flashlight blinks inside the wrecked bus on Lakeshore Avenue.
A flashlight blinks inside the wrecked bus on Lakeshore Avenue.
Sam: Thank God. I lost my rifle in the fighting. Take me with you.
Someone is banging on metal, close by.
Someone is banging on metal, close by.
Dale: You… you’re real. Take me with you.
Knocking from inside the pharmacy.
Knocking from inside the pharmacy.
Rosa: You’re real. I have not seen anyone in hours. Take me with you.
That is everyone. The metro station: it has a shutter, and it has a light.
Down the stairs, quick. Behind you, the shutter rolls shut.
Below, for the first time in a day, someone breathes out.
